stock.description: Vicon Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily offering foundation and related construction services across Hong Kong. The company undertakes a diverse range of foundation projects, encompassing tasks such as piling, excavation and lateral support (ELS) systems, and pile cap construction, alongside various general building endeavors. Additionally, Vicon Holdings provides construction machinery for lease. Its clientele includes property developers, project owners and their designated contractors, and organizations within the public sector. Established in 2016, the firm's headquarters are situated in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
